user.title: Bilresa Remote
user.description: Select your IKEA BILRESA scroll wheel remote (Matter).

data_description.device_id: Only devices from IKEA of Sweden with model 'BILRESA scroll wheel' are listed.

data.volume_use_up_down_for_instant: Use volume up/down actions for instant mode

data_description.dim_step_pct: Change in brightness in % when scrolling.
data_description.dim_min_pct: Minimum brightness in % when dimming down.
data_description.min_color_temp: Minimum color temperature in K (color_temp mode).
data_description.max_color_temp: Maximum color temperature in K (color_temp mode).
data_description.color_temp_step: Change in color temperature in K per scroll click.
data_description.color_hue_step: Change in color hue in degrees per scroll click.
data_description.color_saturation: Color saturation in % used when setting hue.
data_description.light_transition_duration: Duration of light transitions in seconds.
data_description.volume_step_pct: Change in media player volume in % per scroll click.
data_description.volume_use_up_down_for_instant: Instant mode uses volume_up/volume_down instead of the step percentage.
data_description.volume_max_pct: Maximum volume in % for media players.
data_description.fan_step_pct: Change in fan speed in % per scroll click (used when the fan does not report its own step).
data_description.on_hold_delay: Delay between repeated on-hold action calls in seconds.
data_description.max_queued_automation_calls: Maximum number of queued event handlers.
data_description.copy_channels: Copy all settings (actions, targets, modes) from one channel to the others. Applied before channel editing.
data_description.edit_channels: If disabled, only global settings and the channel copy are saved.

data_description.on_hold_action_ch1: Repeated while the button is held, see on hold delay.
data_description.scroll_wheel_target_ch1: Light, media player, or fan entities controlled by the scroll wheel. Empty for user defined mode.
data_description.scroll_wheel_mode_ch1: Attribute of the target entities controlled by the scroll wheel.
data_description.scroll_wheel_mode_dynamic_ch1: For dynamic mode only: an input_select whose current option selects the scroll wheel mode.
data_description.scroll_wheel_mode_ext_ch1: Relaxed: one action after scrolling. Instant: many actions while scrolling (requires the hidden sensor entities to be enabled).
data_description.scroll_wheel_user_action_ch1: For user defined mode only. Variables: scroll_clicks (1-8, always 1 in instant mode), scroll_direction (left or right).
